language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
G'day! Welcome to my barbecue party. It's great to meet you.
I prepared some yummy food and great dishes. And you know what?
My food and dishes have shapes you should know about. Do you know what a shape is?
A shape is something like the outside form of a thing; the way things looks from the outside.
Once you know shapes, life will be more fun because you will see these shapes everywhere around you.
Come and have a look with me at different shapes.
You can see different shapes we are going to look at today.
Well, here is the first shape. This shape is called a square.
Basically, it has 4 corners. You see. It also has 4 sides which are, remember, exactly the same length.
Let me show you some more squares. These all have 4 corners and 4 sides the same length.
The next shape looks similar to the square. But there is a difference. Yes, it also has 4 corners.
But the 4 sides of this shape do not have the same length. This shape is called a rectangle. Let me show you some more of these shapes called rectangles.
Notice that not all 4 sides of each rectangle are of the same length.
Just 2 sides are always of equal length.
Now the next shape has 3 corners. This shape is called a triangle.
Let me show you some more triangles. All triangles have just 3 corners.
Here is a new shape. It has many corners; yep, it has 6 corners. It's called a hexagon. Here I show you some examples of hexagons.
And finally a surprise: a shape with no corners. It's called a circle! Here are a few circles.
Now let's get started preparing food for our BBQ party!
